MR Safety
Non-clinical testing has demonstrated that the Orion Transcatheter Valve is MR Conditional. A patient with this device can be safely scanned in an MR system meeting the following conditions:
- Static magnetic field of 1.5T and 3T
- Spatial field gradient: ≤ 300-Gauss/cm (3-T/m) or less
- Maximum gradient slew rate of 150 T/m/s per axis
- At 1.5 T: Maximum whole body averaged specific absorption rate (SAR) of 0.4 W/kg; Maximum active scan time of 10 minutes
- At 3 T: B1+rms <= 1.7 µT; Maximum Head SAR 3.2 W/kg
- Use the body transmit coil
Under the scan conditions defined above, the Orion Transcatheter Valve is expected to produce a maximum temperature rise of less than 1.6 °C after 15 minutes of continuous scanning.
